appDesc.message: Capture, document and track the web.

privacy_tagline.message: Screenshots never leave your browser unless you choose to upload them.

privacy.message: Screenshots never leave your browser unless you choose to upload them.

ui_result_errorTitle.message: This result could not be opened

ui_result_editorUnavailable.message: The editor will be available from this result.

ui_result_export_downloaded.message: Your file is ready to download.

error_E_EXPORT_body.message: The export could not be completed. Try another format.

onboarding_footer.message: No account. No cloud. Your browser, your work.

onboarding_rail_body.message: Capture long pages as one image, review the result locally and keep the history close.

onboarding_rail_trustBody.message: Your captures stay in this browser until you choose otherwise.

onboarding_step_privacyMeta.message: Clear, local and in your control

onboarding_step_tryMeta.message: Try it on a real webpage

onboarding_welcome_title.message: One clean image for a long page.

onboarding_welcome_body.message: FullPageLab captures the page without splitting it and manages cookie layers and fixed UI by the rules you choose.

onboarding_feature_fullPage_body.message: Capture the active webpage from top to bottom.

onboarding_feature_smart_body.message: Handle fixed UI and cookie layers without dirtying the result.

onboarding_feature_private_body.message: Inspect it locally and decide what leaves your browser.

onboarding_shortcut_body.message: Press Alt + Shift + P whenever you want to capture the active page.

onboarding_privacy_title.message: Your screenshots stay in your browser.

onboarding_privacy_heroBody.message: No account, no upload, no hidden sync.

onboarding_privacy_localBody.message: Images are prepared inside this extension.

onboarding_privacy_permissionBody.message: Optional exports and integrations are user-triggered.

onboarding_privacy_storageBody.message: Let Chrome keep local data available between sessions.

onboarding_privacy_storageDeclined.message: You can enable this later from Options.

onboarding_privacy_telemetryBody.message: Share anonymous diagnostics. Off by default, and never includes screenshots.

onboarding_try_title.message: Make your first capture on a real page.

onboarding_try_body.message: This setup screen is an extension page, so it cannot be prepared for full-page capture. Open a sample webpage, then use the FullPageLab icon there.

onboarding_try_cardTitle.message: A complete page, in one frame.

onboarding_try_cardBody.message: No manual scrolling. No pasted-together pieces.

onboarding_try_boundaryTitle.message: The setup tab cannot be captured

onboarding_try_boundaryBody.message: Chrome does not allow content scripts on extension pages, so FullPageLab will not create a misleading result here.

onboarding_try_boundaryNote.message: Click the FullPageLab icon on the webpage that opens in the new tab.

onboarding_try_startedBody.message: Switch to the new tab and click the FullPageLab icon. Choose Full page to make your first real capture.

onboarding_complete_body.message: Pin FullPageLab to your toolbar and capture the next page when inspiration strikes.

onboarding_pin_body.message: Open the puzzle menu in Chrome and pin FullPageLab for one-click access.
